predecessors.name: Russian Empire
predecessors.text: 'the territory of the former Russian Empire', which the republic claimed (Russian Republic page)

successors.name: Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic
successors.text: the land the Bolsheviks held after 7 November 1917, drawn by Cliopatria as the Russian Republic's 1918 and 1919 shapes

successors.name: Russian State
successors.text: the page names the Russian State as a successor without a territory; its own dossier gives the land

successors.name: Ukrainian People's Republic
successors.text: the governorates the Central Rada claimed on 20 November 1917 (see the Ukrainian People's Republic dossier)

ledger.x: 1917, 14 September (1 September O.S.): Kerensky proclaims the Russian Republic.
1917, 7 November: the Bolsheviks seize power and the republic's government is dissolved.

wars.name: Eastern Front (World War I): Russian war effort to the armistice
wars.outcome: The armistice of 16 December 1917 at Brest-Litovsk and the treaty signed on 3 March 1918 ended the war on this front; the republic's government had already fallen on 7 November 1917.

wars.name: Russian Civil War
wars.outcome: The civil war opens on 7 November 1917, the day the republic's government falls; its territorial results are carried by the RSFSR, Russian State, South Russia and Far Eastern Republic dossiers.

certainty.note: The republic claims the whole Russian Empire, whose treaty frontiers are sharp, but the western and Caucasian fronts were war lines and the page gives no boundary.
